content: Hi! How can I help you with sharing your dataset today?
I'd like to upload my latest CSV files to our shared folder for the team. Can you walk me through it?
Absolutely! First, open the 'Project_Data' folder I shared with you last week. Once you're in, click the 'Upload' button, it's near the top right.
Got it. Should I use any particular naming convention for the files?
Great question. To keep things tidy, please use the format 'projectname_YYYYMMDD_vX.csv', for example, 'surveydata_20240611_v2.csv'. It'll make tracking updates much easier for everyone.
Thanks! I also generated checksums for each file. Where should I put them?

That's such a thoughtful touch. Please upload your checksum files into the same folder, naming them to match their CSVs, like 'surveydata_20240611_v2.sha256'. It helps us verify the originals quickly.
All set, I just uploaded the CSVs and checksums. Should I notify the others?
Perfect! Before you reach out, you can double-check your uploads by browsing the folder, let me know if anything looks off. Once you're happy, feel free to share the folder link with the team.
Everything looks good. Is there a way for the team to download all the files at once?
Absolutely, when they visit the shared folder, there's a 'Download All' option in the menu. That way, everyone gets the originals with the correct filenames and checksums.
That's really convenient. Anything else I should keep in mind to keep things organized?

You're already doing great! If you ever update a dataset, just increment the version in the filename. And if you spot any files missing or out of place, you can always browse the folder and upload as needed.
Thanks for the help! I'll send the link to the team now.
You're welcome! I really appreciate how organized you keep things, it makes collaboration so much smoother. Let me know if you need anything else or want help tracking changes. Have a great day!
